title: literature-review
summary: A reusable literature-review workflow for reviews of any size. The user writes a brief (questions, criteria, tier); scripts search Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv, follow citations, and resolve every candidate so no invented reference survives; two Haiku screeners judge each abstract independently and an Opus checker settles disagreements. Scripts fetch open-access PDFs (Literature/, OpenAlex, arXiv, repositories) and check each is the paper asked for; a preprint or repository copy is compared with the published record; the user supplies any paper not found.

A fresh Sonnet reader per paper extracts claims with verbatim quotes, pages and equations from page images and Marker text; core papers are read twice independently. A script checks every quote and equation against the page; an Opus checker, blind to the reader's reasoning, judges every claim on the page image. A script (the curator) is the only writer to the library and refuses anything unchecked; nothing is ever deleted. Memos cite claim IDs only, are checked by script and by a Fable checker, a tag report after each wave proposes merges and new tags, and the user decides whether to close, expand or retract the review and which tag changes to accept. A calibration run with planted errors gates the first real wave.
status: Draft design for review, 2026-10-23, revision 2 (user decisions applied). Nothing built. Details and open decisions: WORKFLOW.md.

nodes.title: U0 Brief
nodes.job: Writes the questions, inclusion and exclusion criteria, tier (S, M, L), seed papers and queries with the main session.
details: Versioned: each wave records its brief version
Tier S skips discovery and screening

nodes.title: brief.vN.json
nodes.job: The review's questions, criteria, tier, seeds, queries and limits.

nodes.title: D1 discover.py
nodes.job: Runs the brief's queries on Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and arXiv and follows references and citations of seeds.
details: Every query logged: API, date, result count
An API failure is logged; the wave continues

nodes.title: D2 morty-scout (tier M, L)
nodes.job: Searches the web for work the APIs miss (theses, recent preprints, other terms) and returns citations only.
details: Cannot fetch or write
Fresh per question

nodes.title: search/ snapshots
nodes.job: Raw API responses with hashes and dates, so the candidate set can be reproduced.

nodes.title: D3 resolve.py
nodes.job: Resolves every candidate in Crossref or OpenAlex and removes duplicates by DOI and title.
details: Unresolvable citation: dropped and logged
Catches invented references

nodes.title: candidates.json
nodes.job: Deduplicated candidates with DOI, title, abstract and where each was found.

nodes.title: C0 calibrate.py (once per prompt or model change)
nodes.job: Runs screening and E1 to E4 on planted errors, a gold recall set and off-topic abstracts before any real wave.
details: Gates SC1 and E1: no real wave until it passes
Pass: all fabricated quotes and wrong pages caught, 90 % of other errors
Gold set: E1 finds 90 %, E1 + E2 find all
Fails: stop and revise prompts

nodes.title: SC1 jerry-screener x2 (tier M, L)
nodes.job: Two independent screeners judge each title and abstract: core, context or exclude, with the deciding criterion.
details: Neither sees the other's decision
Fresh per batch of 10

nodes.title: SC2 compare_screens.py
nodes.job: Compares the two screens and lists the disagreements.

nodes.title: SC3 beth-checker (task: screen)
nodes.job: Decides each disagreement from the abstract and both reasons.
details: Gets only the disagreements
Cannot tell: goes to the user at U1

nodes.title: U1 Approve shortlist
nodes.job: Reviews every core and context paper, 10 % of excluded ones, and the queries with their counts.
details: Adds or removes papers

nodes.title: shortlist.json
nodes.job: Approved papers with tier and the questions each bears on; no relevance score.

nodes.title: A1 acquire.py
nodes.job: Finds each paper in Literature/, then as open access (OpenAlex, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, repositories), and checks its first page.
details: Each download in its own new folder
Wrong paper: not acquired, logged
Not found: listed in fetch_list.md
No institutional access; no Sci-Hub

nodes.title: Literature/incoming/<review>/
nodes.job: Acquired PDFs with path and SHA-256 in acquired.json.

nodes.title: U2 Supply missing papers
nodes.job: Supplies any listed paper they already have, or marks it unavailable; accepts or rejects copies A2 flagged.
details: A1 and A2 re-run on what the user adds

nodes.title: P1 prepare.py
nodes.job: Renders page images, runs Marker (OCR to Markdown with LaTeX) and crops figures with captions.
details: Text layer never used
A failed page cannot be cited

nodes.title: pages/, marker/, figures/
nodes.job: Page PNGs, Marker pages and figure crops, all hashed; local only (copyright).

nodes.title: E1 morty-reader (E2: second independent read of core papers)
nodes.job: Reads one paper and writes its card and claims: text, kind, verbatim quote, page, equation, figure, questions, tags, basis.
details: Fresh per paper; no web
Tags only from vocab.yaml; new ones proposed
Instructions found in a paper are flagged, not followed

nodes.title: reads/<paper>.A.json, .B.json
nodes.job: The reader's paper card and claims, one file per read.

nodes.title: E3 check_extraction.py
nodes.job: Finds each quote on its cited page, compares equations with Marker, checks page coverage and diffs read A against read B.
details: Equations: normalised strings, SymPy where both parse
Claims found by one reader only go to E4

nodes.title: E4 beth-checker (task: claim)
nodes.job: Judges every claim on its page image: supported, overstated, unsupported or wrong page; settles equation disagreements.
details: Never sees the reader's reasoning
Fresh per page

nodes.title: verdicts.json
nodes.job: Verdict per claim and equation with location on the page and reason.

nodes.title: E5 morty-reader (revise, at most 2 rounds)
nodes.job: Rewrites a failed claim from the page and the checker's reason; the rewrite is checked again.
details: Still failing after 2 rounds: goes to U3

nodes.title: U3 Inspect
nodes.job: Inspects every disputed claim and equation, and 60 random passed claims beside their page crops.
details: No error in 60: passed-claim error rate below 4.9 % (95 %)
Sample size still to be decided

nodes.title: L1 curator.py (only writer)
nodes.job: Publishes items that have a citation, a quote match and a passing verdict or user decision; refuses all others.
details: Hashes files, sets them read-only, logs an event
Corrections are new versions; nothing is deleted
Retraction only by the user, with a reason

nodes.title: library/
nodes.job: Paper cards and claims as versioned JSON files, tags from vocab.yaml, events log; catalog.sqlite is an index rebuilt from the files.
details: views/: one Markdown page per tag and review

nodes.title: L2 audit.py
nodes.job: Re-hashes every library file and rebuilds the catalog from the files to compare.
details: Any mismatch: stop and report to the user

nodes.title: morty-librarian (reference desk)
nodes.job: Answers requests about the library with records quoted verbatim, through a read-only, logged query script.
details: Every request states its purpose
Cannot write or delete

nodes.title: Y1 beth-synthesizer
nodes.job: Writes one memo per question from verified claims, citing claim IDs and marking its own inference.
details: Fresh per question
Lists what the literature does not answer

nodes.title: Y2 check_citations.py
nodes.job: Checks each memo sentence cites a verified claim and every number in it appears in a cited claim.
details: Failures go back to Y1 with the list

nodes.title: Y3 rick-checker
nodes.job: Checks each memo statement against the cited claims, and lists missed contradictions and gaps.
details: Different model family from the synthesizer
Unsupported: Y1 revises once, then the user sees it

nodes.title: memos/<review>/Qk.vN.md
nodes.job: Checked memo per question, published through the curator.

nodes.title: U4 Decide
nodes.job: Reads memos, checker report, gaps and tag proposals; closes, expands or retracts the review; accepts or rejects tag changes.
details: Pillar 1: memo ends with model options

nodes.title: A2 check_copy.py (non-publisher copies)
nodes.job: Compares a preprint or repository copy with the published record: title, authors, abstract, errata.
details: Copy kind recorded on every claim read from it
Title or authors differ: user decides at U2
Published version later: claims re-checked

nodes.title: T1 tag_report.py (after every wave)
nodes.job: Counts tag use and lists tags with similar names or mostly the same claims, unused tags and provisional tags.

nodes.title: T2 morty-tagger
nodes.job: Proposes tag merges, splits, renames, deprecations and promotions, each with a reason.
details: Proposals only; the user accepts each at U4
Accepted: new vocab.yaml version with alias map
